name: Broke
subtitle: Shamali's own builds
description: Built ipas for Broke — the offline-first personal finance app. Source code is private; only the binary is published here.

apps.name: Broke
apps.subtitle: Money tracking that works with no internet
apps.localizedDescription: Broke keeps every wallet, transaction, goal, debt and bill in a database on this phone. No account, no login, no server — it works in airplane mode. 3ammo still has opinions about your spending.

versions.localizedDescription: Offline-first: the phone is now the source of truth. Local database, no backend, no login. Mutual-debt offsetting, repeating bills, and a from-zero reset.
